steps.text:
Use `grey` only with a shade when styling through `sx`:

```tsx
<Box sx={{ backgroundColor: 'grey.500' }} />
// or
<Box sx={{ bgcolor: (theme) => theme.palette.grey[500] }} />
```

`backgroundColor` is theme-aware in `sx`, so `'grey'` resolves to `theme.palette.grey`, which is a color-scale object—not a valid CSS color. `'gray'` works because it is not a MUI palette key and is passed through as the CSS named color.

`makeStyles` did not apply this palette lookup, which explains the v4/v5 difference. MUI’s palette intentionally uses the British spelling `grey`; its entries are shades such as `grey.50` through `grey.900`. [MUI `sx` palette behavior](https://mui.com/system/getting-started/the-sx-prop/)
